summary: Q1 2026 (reported April 29, 2026): revenue $2.48B, net income $319.5M, EPS up YoY, but full-year guidance lowered on higher R&D spend and old MS drug pressure. Growth drugs: LEQEMBI $168M (+74% YoY, market leader by patient share US/Japan/China), SKYCLARYS $151M (+22% YoY, ex-US > US first time). Pipeline: pivotal data readouts and regulatory milestones starting fiscal Q2 2026. Pending Apellis acquisition ($5.6B); felzartamab Greater China rights from TJ Biopharma up to $850M.
